articles.title: Spain v England Player Ratings
articles.summary: Spanish football reporter Elizabeth Conway and senior football correspondent Sami Mokbel share their individual player ratings following the international fixture between Spain and England.

articles.title: Aberdeen Name Frick Head Coach
articles.summary: Aberdeen have announced the appointment of former Liechtenstein international striker Mario Frick as their new head coach.

articles.title: Ronaldinho Returns in Ravenna Win
articles.summary: Brazil legend Ronaldinho made his football comeback at the age of 46, playing the first half of Ravenna's Italian third-tier derby match against Forli.

articles.title: Wenger Rules Out FIFA Run
articles.summary: Arsene Wenger has decided against running for the FIFA presidency, providing a significant boost to Gianni Infantino's ambitions of securing a fourth term in office.

articles.title: London City Chase Top Three
articles.summary: Following the opening ten matches of the Women's Super League season, London City Lionesses have demonstrated that they possess the capability to finish inside the top three places.

articles.title: Man Utd Eye Bassey and Collins
articles.summary: Manchester United are reportedly targeting Fulham defender Calvin Bassey and Brentford's Nathan Collins, while AC Milan are keen on taking Real Madrid's Endrick on loan.

articles.title: Pocognoli Inspired By Van Gaal
articles.summary: Scotland head coach Sebastien Pocognoli has revealed that he draws heavily upon the managerial influence and philosophy of iconic coach Louis van Gaal during his own career.

articles.title: Hendon Match Abandoned After Injury
articles.summary: Hendon's first fixture since the death of midfielder Ezekiel Williams had to be abandoned following a serious injury sustained by player Ethan Creary.

articles.title: Crash Survivor Wins Promotion
articles.summary: Alan Ruschel, one of only six survivors of the tragic 2016 plane crash carrying the Chapecoense squad, secured promotion to Brazil's Serie A in the final match before his retirement.

articles.title: Northern Ireland Target Victory
articles.summary: Although a draw away against Hungary on Tuesday would be enough to secure Nations League promotion for Northern Ireland, the team is actively targeting all three points in Budapest.

articles.title: Tenerife Return Following Tragedy
articles.summary: Tenerife played their first fixture since the sudden death of striker Jesus de Miguel during an emotional afternoon at the Heliodoro Rodriguez Lopez stadium.

articles.title: Why English Stars Move Abroad
articles.summary: High-profile English footballers such as Harry Kane, Jude Bellingham, and Anthony Gordon have chosen to pursue their club football careers outside of England.

articles.title: England Top Group After Spain Win
articles.summary: Thomas Tuchel's revamped England team delivered an extraordinary performance in Madrid, overcoming an early red card and a fierce Spanish fightback to secure victory and top their Nations League group.

articles.title: Earps Inspires London City Draw
articles.summary: Arsenal recorded their fifth consecutive home draw in the Women's Super League after being held to a 1-1 stalemate by London City Lionesses, largely due to an inspired display from goalkeeper Mary Earps.

articles.title: Robertson Scotland's Finest Captain
articles.summary: As he surpasses Kenny Dalglish's appearance total to reach 103 caps, Andy Robertson has cemented his status as Scotland's finest-ever captain through his remarkable international journey.

articles.title: Ronaldinho Debuts For Ravenna
articles.summary: Former Brazil star Ronaldinho played 45 minutes for Italian Serie C side Ravenna at age 46, returning to professional football eleven years after seemingly ending his playing career.

articles.title: Butcher On Maradona And England
articles.summary: Former England centre-back Terry Butcher reflects on his career, answering questions about Diego Maradona, manager Bobby Robson, and receiving his official England legacy cap.

articles.title: AFC Wimbledon And Fan Ownership
articles.summary: AFC Wimbledon highlights the unique challenges, complexities, and financial realities faced by supporter-owned football clubs operating outside the backing of extremely wealthy proprietors.

articles.title: Mass Brawl Mars New York Friendly
articles.summary: A pre-season friendly fixture between the New York Red Bulls and Club America erupted into a mass brawl, resulting in five red cards and objects being thrown from the stands.

articles.title: Pochettino's Manchester United Arrival
articles.summary: Mauricio Pochettino's arrival at Manchester United is analyzed as another managerial appointment that arguably should have been made several years earlier.

articles.title: Denmark Stun Portugal In Rout
articles.summary: Denmark secured an impressive 4-1 victory away against Portugal in the Nations League, highlighted by a superb double from Rasmus Hojlund in their first match since Cristiano Ronaldo's international retirement.

articles.title: Reflecting On Pochettino's US Tenure
articles.summary: Mauricio Pochettino's tenure as head coach of the United States men's national team brought a wave of highs and lows ahead of the upcoming home World Cup.

articles.title: De La Fuente Hits Out At Lies
articles.summary: Spain head coach Luis de la Fuente has lashed out at media rumors regarding alleged preferential treatment for young star Lamine Yamal ahead of their crucial match against England.

articles.title: Portugal Retire Ronaldo's No 7
articles.summary: Portugal have permanently preserved the design of the No 7 shirt to honor Cristiano Ronaldo's legendary international career, which included 146 goals over 23 years and 246 appearances.

articles.title: Ten-Man England Defeat Spain
articles.summary: England successfully withstood a strong fightback from Spain despite playing with ten men following Elliot Anderson's red card, securing a famous 3-2 victory to top their Nations League group.

articles.title: Arsenal Held By London City Again
articles.summary: Arsenal's winless home run in the Women's Super League continued as they registered a fifth straight draw at the Emirates, tied 1-1 by London City Lionesses thanks to Mary Earps.

articles.title: Scotland Edge Past Australia
articles.summary: Scotland secured a hard-fought 15-12 victory over Australia in a tight Nations Championship encounter, though they were ultimately left disappointed without securing a bonus point.

articles.title: Pioneer Pete Triumphs At Cheltenham
articles.summary: Pioneer Pete underlined his rising status in the two-mile hurdling division by securing a victory in the Unibet Greatwood Handicap Hurdle at Cheltenham.

articles.title: Fisher Targetting Prenga Fight
articles.summary: Boxer Johnny Fisher is aiming for a return to the ring early next year and has expressed interest in fighting Kristian Prenga.

articles.title: England Level ODI Series In Style
articles.summary: England comprehensively leveled their ODI series against Australia with a 135-run victory in Adelaide, aided by a successful tactical switch to bowler Baker with the World Cup in mind.

articles.title: Gilding Wins Grand Slam Thriller
articles.summary: Andrew Gilding capitalized on Charlie Manby's erratic finishing to secure a victory on the bullseye during their Grand Slam of Darts match.

articles.title: Sayers Challenges Cummins Statement
articles.summary: Former Australian cricketer Chadd Sayers has publicly disputed Pat Cummins' version of the infamous ball-tampering scandal, stating his belief that the entire team was aware.
